build_gcs_read: build a python module to read a file from Google Cloud Storage using GCSStorageService
build_gcs_write: build a python module to write data to a file on Google Cloud Storage using GCSStorageService
build_gcs_copy: build a python module to copy files between local storage and GCS or between GCS buckets
build_gcs_upload_dir: build a python module to recursively upload a local directory to a GCS bucket
build_gcs_delete: build a python module to delete a file from Google Cloud Storage using GCSStorageService
